signal: Bolt launched a new payments platform in late 2025 and partnered with Toffee in Feb 2026, while running lean on headcount.

email.subject1: more reach from a lean SDR team
email.body1:
Kevin, saw Bolt has been pushing its new platform and fresh partnerships while keeping the team lean.

That combination usually means more accounts to follow up with than the enterprise SD team can physically touch, and good leads cool off waiting in the queue. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and multi-channel follow-up, so your reps spend time in live conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top enterprise accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for your SD team.

Response speed and follow-up volume are usually where lean teams leak meetings: a 15-touch, three-week cadence is hard to run by hand on top of everything else. Multi-channel sequencing alone drives 287% more responses than single channel in our data.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I'd make first, plus how the worker runs the cadence so your reps focus on the conversations that book.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for your team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the SD team could touch and couldn't hire fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer enterprise SD teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kevin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If squeezing more meetings out of the current SD team isn't the priority right now, no problem at all. I know a lean team has plenty competing for attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise SD motion? I'll tailor it to Bolt either way.
